text: Pinned source review establishes that pymovements 0.28.0 smooth supports moving_average, exponential_moving_average and savitzky_golay, not median. The frozen protocol therefore treats both median filtering and bounded gap interpolation as eyes4s-only absolute/scaling cells; only Savitzky-Golay in this ticket is paired. Do not silently substitute another Python library to invent equivalence. The high-rate binocular fixture now contains sustained 20-sample movement so microsaccade minimum-duration tests cannot pass vacuously on isolated jumps.
